note_on_explained: Changes the register declares and no span carries. Four kinds: an edit inside an excluded block, a deletion whose text is not in the final version, an edit that left the attribution where it was, and an edit a later one replaced. Written on 23 August 2026, under a rule made after this case was sealed; the reasons were reconstructed from the register, not from memory.

3.note: ATTRIBUTION CHANGED from U to UA. The user wrote this paragraph and compressed it; the AI then rewrote the opening on the user's instruction to split a sixty-word sentence, and the user accepted option B in full. Most of the user's vocabulary survives, but 'Ma l'AI serve proprio a estenderlo' is the AI's construction and there is no traceable boundary inside two short sentences. Leaving this at U would have been the comfortable call and the wrong one.
